verdict.rationale: Lithic is a card-issuing/payments API platform; its AI-related evidence describes an MCP server that lets external AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) connect to and call Lithic's API, not a built-in assistant embedded inside Lithic's own product for users to delegate tasks to. This is the reverse integration direction, so the axis of a native in-product AI assistant does not apply.
